files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
Carl Penke Farm
The barn sits on a stone foundation and is clad with vertical board and batten siding.

files.title: File:Carl Penke Farm Douglas Co NE Barn north and west facades.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
Carl Penke Farm
The oldest building on this farm is the gable-roofed barn constructed sometime in the 1880's.

files.title: File:Carl Penke Farm Douglas Co NE Barn west facade.jpg
files.author: SharonPapierdreams
files.caption:
Carl Penke Farm
The west side of the barn is punctuated by a two over two fixed window at either end, two side-by-side double Dutch doors positioned slightly off center and a centered dormer entrance.
